description: Compare the total cost of keeping existing home and auto insurance with standalone umbrella coverage versus moving all three to a bundle. Enter annual net premiums, required underlying-limit upgrades, and one-time switching cost. Returns first-year and multi-year totals, savings, and the first whole break-even year. Flags unverified coverage comparability; no carrier prices are invented.
